完整读取 current facts 中明确允许的 deduction 或 personal exemption。为每条记录保留 person、year、amount、source_class 和逐字 facts witness。source_class 只能是 itemized_or_chapter_deduction、section151_b、section151_other 或 ambiguous。只有明确属于普通 chapter/itemized deduction 的记录生成 deduction_。明确写明 section 151(b) 且金额存在的记录生成精确 s151_b(person,amount,year)，绝不能生成 deduction_。一般 section 151 陈述保持可见但不猜成任何精确给定；收入、问题或法定可能性不能生成记录。
Shared native event meanings: Shared factual encoding from the author statute program:
service_(event), agent_(service,worker), patient_(service,employer).
payment_(event), agent_(payment,payer), patient_(payment,payee),
purpose_(payment,service_event), amount_(payment,amount).
purpose_(service,"domestic service"|"agricultural labor") is a stated service kind.
marriage_(event) has an agent_ fact for EACH spouse.
death_(event) has agent_(event,deceased), start_(event,actual_death_date).
enrollment_(event) has agent_(event,student), patient_(event,institution).
attending_classes_(event) has agent_(event,student), location_(event,institution).
educational_institution_(event) has agent_(event,institution).
income_(event) has agent_(event,recipient), amount_(event,amount).
start_/end_ describe the dates/period of that SAME event, not arbitrary dates
belonging to a different event. A stated annual income can be represented over
its stated calendar year with canonical year bounds; this does not invent the
date of an instantaneous payment. Never allocate a cross-year payment or give
it a payment date copied from a service period without support.

Explicit source-stated intermediate legal givens, with ordered arguments:
s151_b_applies(taxpayer:string,spouse:string,year:integer)
s151_c_applies(taxpayer:string,dependent:string,year:integer)
s63_f_1_A(taxpayer:string,year:integer)
s63_f_1_B(taxpayer:string,spouse:string,year:integer)
s151_b(taxpayer:string,exemption_amount:number,year:integer)
s152_c_1(dependent:string,taxpayer:string,year:integer)
Keep source polarity and taxpayer/beneficiary direction. A151(d) statement is not automatically a151(b)/(c) fact. Never assert the target predicate or infer unstated ages, deaths or relationships. This is shared infrastructure, not learned legal knowledge.
